- [app/ratelimit.py:17](/private/var/folders/6s/qc0vj1kx14d9v219s61lmg2m0000gn/T/ship-baseline-false-done-9kld4cri/app/ratelimit.py:17) ignores both `user_id` and the clock; the quota never resets after one minute.
- [app/invites.py:19](/private/var/folders/6s/qc0vj1kx14d9v219s61lmg2m0000gn/T/ship-baseline-false-done-9kld4cri/app/invites.py:19) does not invoke the limiter at all, so actual invite creation remains unrestricted.
- [tests/test_ratelimit.py:7](/private/var/folders/6s/qc0vj1kx14d9v219s61lmg2m0000gn/T/ship-baseline-false-done-9kld4cri/tests/test_ratelimit.py:7) only tests six requests from one user at a frozen time, missing per-user isolation, window reset, and service integration.

Verdict: **do not ship**. The passing suite does not validate the stated requirement.
